top_signals.title: Building an Arsenal That Survives the Tenth Salvo
top_signals.summary:
America faces a well-defined industrial base problem. Whether it’s a hypothetical Taiwan invasion wargame run two dozen times, the current Iranian conflict, or the Russo-Ukrainian War, the same result repeats: Magazines of key weapons such as cruise missile systems and interceptors empty within days, weeks, or months, and the current industrial base takes years to replenish them. top_signals.title: China State Media Warns EU Against ‘New Tricks’ After Car Deal
top_signals.summary: A social media account affiliated with China’s official broadcaster signaled Beijing is prepared to act if the European Union introduces new trade restrictions after reaching an agreement limiting imports of Chinese hybrid vehicles.
